title: Mike Hanopol seeks NBI help over online bullying, unauthorized song use
summary: Rock legend Mike Hanopol of Juan Dela Cruz band sought help from the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Wednesday over alleged bullying and unauthorized use of his songs.
